descricao_original: The entire digestive tract is innervated by the enteric subdivision of the autonomic nervous system, controlling smooth muscle contraction, secretion and blood flow. The enteric nervous system consists of two components: the submucosal (Meissner’s) plexus located in the submucosa and the myenteric (Auerbach’s) plexus located between the muscle layers of the muscularis externa. Each plexus consists of neurons in small ganglia interconnected by a network of unmyelinated axons that eventually innervate the tissues. 200x, 800x
creditos_identificados: Image source: The images were taken of a slide in the New England College of Osteopathic Medicine collection.
